concepts.summary: INTENT.md + LEDGER.md schema validation and acceptance-criterion lint helper. validate_intent checks frontmatter required fields (artifact/slug/level/generated_at/frozen_at/planning_mode) and required sections per level: acceptance checklist always required; not-doing + consider-for-this required at L2+ (standard|deep). lint-criteria flags bare 'runs'/'works' criteria with no observable object following. CLI: python3 scripts/intent-schema.py validate-intent|lint-criteria|validate-ledger <file>. Shell wrapper: bash scripts/session-helpers.sh validate_intent <INTENT.md> [lint]. Exit 0=valid, 1=errors found, 2=usage error.

Durable external artifact base + lockless cross-session awareness registry with per-file lease/wait system. Five-tier base fallback (Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR > XDG_STATE_HOME > HOME/.local/state > git-common-dir > pwd/z-harness) with anchor enforcement prevents split-brain. Per-run schema-v2 JSON records (held_paths, waiting_on) enable advisory per-file leases: claim (lexicographic tiebreak, won-set-only persist), release (per-task success), wait-for (poll loop with budget, waiting_on cleared on every exit via finally), overlaps (scope + held_conflict). Five wait/lease env knobs: Z_HARNESS_AUTO_WAIT, Z_HARNESS_AUTO_WAIT_BUDGET_SECS, Z_HARNESS_WAIT_POLL_SECS, Z_HARNESS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS, Z_HARNESS_WAIT_REQUIRE_MERGE (deferred). Reaper live-local-pid carve-out: confirmed-alive local pids past 2x stale are marked stale but NOT deleted. Addresses the 2026-06-01 git clean incident.

Specialized subagents, including auditors/reviewers, implementers, doc-updaters (Tier 1 mechanical + Tier 2 structural), consultants, scope classifiers, reconciliation judges, the advisory planning-router for ambiguous plan-family route decisions, and ideator-clusterer (Haiku agent that collapses N wide-mode brainstorm framings into K distinct directions).

Advisory behavioral rules mined from z-harness interaction history; lifecycle raw->candidate->approved with explicit user approval gate; five /z-axiom-* commands; KERNEL.md compiled by build-kernel.py and read by six behavioral subagents; axioms are the lowest-authority signal in the resolver — config/memory win direct conflicts but the conflict is surfaced via axiom_conflict envelope.

Per-host fidelity tiers and command-capability grid for all z-harness export targets. Adapter hosts: native (claude) = full orchestration; high (antigravity) = native skills, multi-agent degraded; flattened (cursor, codex) = transliterated rules, multi-agent blocked. Export-only hosts (windsurf=curated rules with trigger frontmatter; kiro=curated steering with inclusion frontmatter; cline=single pointer file; copilot=single instructions file) have NO adapter-registry entry — registry.select() raises UnknownHostError for them (M5 invariant).

Slash command surfaces: planning-family route checks, contextual exits, plan_route_decision telemetry, review-family finding promotion, config.py export-env/should-notify wrappers, check-no-ask halt branches (7 commands), /z-overnight unattended pipeline orchestrator, /z-grill requirements-interview, /z-explain one-shot code explanation and /z-learn interactive tutor (four shared depth lenses), /z-git-guardrails PreToolUse hook installer, follow-up sink consumer commands (6 /z-followup-* commands), /z-where concurrent-run diagnostic, and persona-rotation (experiment.persona_rotation knob): random implementer draw + dual reviewer dispatch in z-implement-all/z-implement-next, fixed 5-panel consult in z-plan/z-debug, ideator/audit_persona/advisory-consult-arm draws.

Unified config concept covering Loader API (4-layer TOML loader: get, export-env, ensure-defaults, explain, should-notify) and Workflow Resolver (resolve-question, set, list-question-ids, [workflow] section, routing-preference memory schema, elevation proposer), and the [experiment] section (experiment.persona_rotation default true, experiment.control_every_n default 5) governing the persona-rotation feature.

LLM-free pre-run token-cost estimator (3 tiers: static/dispatch/empirical with parent-rollup + static-floor clamp), profile schema (token-cost-profiles.json), gate helper (pre-run-cost-gate.sh), workflow.pre_run_cost_gate enum gate + cost.token_budget integer knob; hard gates (z-research/z-uplift/z-plan-split) require user confirmation; soft gates (z-brainstorm HEAVY/z-audit HEAVY/z-debug) auto-proceed; overnight/no-ask budget rule; cost_gate_decision event.
Haiku-tier subagent for external retrieval (web docs, public APIs, library docs) that offloads lookups from main context while enforcing a read-only verb-blocklist.

Durable follow-up registry draining out-of-scope discoveries into a priority-ordered lifecycle-tracked work queue. Three sinks (project, global, Notion mirror); conservative open->running->verify->done state machine; three completion paths (human-confirmed, audit-confirmed, auto-closed-low-risk). Shared module followup_common.py centralizes the two-tier lock model (per-entry + global cross-tool flock with .hb.lock-serialized holder JSON), batched config reads, and backgrounded Notion push. Event-sourced index.jsonl with incremental checkpoint rebuild (T010), compaction to index.archive.jsonl, corruption detection/repair, and materialized notion_sync_pending state.
Output envelope contract (STATUS line + fixed Markdown sections) that all external/domain lookup subagents must emit.

Pipeline translating z-harness source files into Cursor (.mdc rules), Codex CLI (AGENTS.md + prompts), and Antigravity (workflows + rules + prompts); /z-export slash command; per-target CAPABILITIES.md documents dropped constructs. Personas export from personas/builtin/ for cursor/codex/agy.

Linear pipeline orchestrator that chains z-harness sub-commands unattended with halt-only interaction; Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt set only around Skill calls; 12 instrumented callsites (9 resolver + 3 new gates); flock-guarded overnight-state.json; MORNING_REPORT.md written on every terminal transition; resume via /z-overnight resume <RUN_ID>.

Persona feature surface: layered persona registry (builtin < user-global < repo-local, last wins), three-axis binding (persona/model/runtime), contract enforcement per role, per-target export adapters, and persona-rotation experiment (random-for-role, forced-control, control-counter subcommands; boring-anchor as control; selection_source enum; persona_random_selected + persona_attempt_outcome + extended persona_bound telemetry).

pi export target: builds pi (https://pi.dev) resources from z-harness source files. Unlike Cursor/Codex/agy, pi has no native subagent dispatch — fan-out runs through a vendored subagent extension. Semantic model tier mapping (haiku→deepseek-v4-flash, sonnet/opus→deepseek-v4-pro) with cheap subagents pinned to flash for token efficiency. Agent .md files are rendered with pipelined _yaml_quote on descriptions to prevent YAML parsing failures. The explore agent (pi-only) is a read-only fan-out recon agent for parallel dispatch. pi-mcp-server.py is an MCP server wrapping pi-cli for Hermes Agent orchestration (pi_instruct + pi_inspect_model tools). Four-layer defense against YAML dispatch bug: (1) pi runtime quoteUnquotedColonValues() patch, (2) source quoting in pi_assets, (3) export-pi.py _yaml_quote for all generated agents, (4) post-export _validate_frontmatter_yaml() pass with strict YAML 1.2 parser. Standalone lint-frontmatter.sh + make lint-frontmatter for source-level validation. CI wiring recommended but not yet implemented.

Hard slug-level claim lock for /z-plan and /z-audit-plan preventing silent double-work by concurrent sessions. Orthogonal to the lockless awareness registry (Invariant 1 — registry stays advisory, claim lock is a hard mutex). Thin wrapper scripts/plan-claim.sh over sink-lock.sh; lock path via plan-path.sh:claims_dir(). Holder string: <session_id>::<run_id>::<command>. Acquire exit codes: 0=acquired/self-reentry/disabled, 1=live-peer (holder JSON stdout, TOCTOU/display-only), 2=stale-takeover (we hold, normal post-crash path), 3=corrupt. Heartbeat exit 9=confirmed-lost-claim only (transient read error is heartbeat_error+exit-0, not exit-9). Release always exit-0 (best-effort). Env-only knobs (not TOML keys): Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_TTL_SECS (2700), Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_OVERRIDE (unattended proceed), Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_DISABLE=1 (escape hatch; release is safe no-op). Manual unlock: rm <claims_dir>/<slug>.lock{,.hb.lock}.
Canonical plan layout under z-harness/plans/<slug>/; Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR override; dual-read fallback from legacy z-harness/<slug>/; migrate-plan-layout.sh for bulk or per-slug migration.

Config-file registry routing consultant/reviewer dispatches to any CLI-addressable LLM; three fixed roles mapped to named provider entries; resolution via scripts/resolve-provider.sh. Schema v2 uses -cli provider names with dual-entry + aliases for forward-compat. TOML [roles.*.*] bindings are preferred; providers.json.roles is legacy fallback.

Post-run Haiku subagent that proposes 0-3 candidate memories from a completed /z-implement-all (Phase 9), /z-review-all (Phase 7), or /z-debug (Phase 10, shipped branch only) run. Reads run events, cumulative diff, SPEC.md or DEBUG.md; emits structured candidates as a fenced JSON block. Does not write — orchestrator owns all writes via /z-suggest-memory. Dispatched after skip-conditions check by scripts/run-memory-review.sh.

Unified Run Brief receipt emitted at finalize for 11 v1 registry commands. Chat renders a warm glyph-titled Briefing (What/How/Key decisions/Result/Next) via render-run-brief.py; decision why is surfaced; orchestrator authors approach via run-brief.sh set-section, scrape is empty-only fallback. JSON canonical in archive/$RUN/run-brief.json.

Utility shell/Python scripts forming the operational backbone: structured event telemetry (log-event.sh/log-phase.sh), config/workflow resolver (config.py), git-safety PreToolUse hook (block-dangerous-git.sh), active-plan registry (active-plan-registry.py), persona-rotation analysis (persona-stats.py), follow-up sink subsystem (sink-*), and supporting test/preflight scripts.

SESSION.md handoff artifact + context-curator Haiku subagent that eliminate O(N^2) cache_read growth in /z-implement-all. Notable-only breadcrumbs (E2) feed the curator; curator folds events delta + git diff + TASKS.md into a bounded SESSION.md at the compaction breakpoint (E3); done-set hash predicate re-seeds orchestrator context on resume (E1). Key env knobs: Z_SESSION_CURATOR_TIMEOUT_S (default 120, 0 disables) and Z_SESSION_MAX_CHARS (default 28000).

Configuration cockpit: inspect resolved state, run guided concern-grouped wizard, or apply a posture preset (interactive/overnight/ci-batch). CLI is scripts/setup.py; /z-setup skill is the slash-command surface. Seven wizard scopes (all lowercase): notifications, workflow, overnight, providers, personas, docs, memories.
Lightweight bug-fix command for the case where the user already has a diagnosis; single light-fix consult, inline implementation, non-negotiable Codex review, optional post-mortem.

Conversational bounded idea-sharpener. Probes, reframes, and converges a vague idea into a buildable problem statement; escalates to pin fuzzy dimensions only as needed (bounded — never full /z-grill exhaustiveness). Writes GRILL.md (not BRAINSTORM.md) as precontext for /z-plan or /z-brainstorm; also auto-invoked as /z-brainstorm Phase 0. Three logging events: sharpen_run_start, sharpen_convergence, sharpen_run_end.

Cheap parallel pre-plan ideation with conversational discussion/selection tail. Phase 0: sharpen-vs-skip gate (auto-invokes /z-sharpen inline when topic is vague); NL count parse (WIDE_N from prose, default 3); scope probe (LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY); wide×HEAVY suppression (D2). Phase 2b: 3 vendor-diverse ideators; Phase 2c (WIDE_N>3): phased overflow waves + ideator-clusterer to collapse N framings→K directions. Phase 3: ranked prose briefing (pros/cons/consensus/divergence/recommendation) + end-turn guardrail — MUST NOT auto-decide. Phase 4 LIGHT/MEDIUM: discussion loop (ask/challenge/combine/re-spin/lock-in/abandon); synthesized is the default chosen_framing for discussion-born hybrids. Phase 4 HEAVY: ranked-pair briefing + end-turn (replaces AskUserQuestion matrix). Config knob: brainstorm.wide_overflow_model (default haiku; cheap-mixed gated/no-op).

Haiku subagent for wide /z-brainstorm runs (WIDE_N > 3). Reads N peer ideator framing blocks from BRAINSTORM.md, clusters them into K distinct directions by core hypothesis / approach axis. Returns: K cluster labels + members + representative framing (verbatim), effective-diversity report (N→K, which collapsed), cross-cluster consensus. Read-only. Distinct from scope-reconciler-brainstorm (which operates on the chunk axis in HEAVY mode); this agent operates on the divergence axis (N peers, same topic).
Explicit in-place plugin update via /z-update; detects symlink vs tarball mode; git pull --ff-only for symlink, atomic swap for tarball; no autoupdate; version tracked by scripts/version.sh.
Tiered bulk codebase quality uplift: decompose into components, repo-wide cross-cutting pass, per-component audits, sequential implement via /z-implement-all.

Machine-readable agent handoff protocol for session continuity. Defines handoff.json contract (JSON Schema draft 2020-12) with 7 fields: protocol_version (const 1.0), timestamp, agent, slug, status (enum: context_pressure/clean_break/complete/blocked), next_step, context_files (array of {path, role}). Universal across pi, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and any z-harness agent. Skill + command write handoff.json to workspace root atomically; orchestrator consumes it and spawns the next session. Roles: spec, plan, tasks, workstreams, session_log, diff, other. Pre-existing handoff.json is overwritten. write-handoff.sh automates producer-side at compaction breakpoints.

Tier 1 Flash subagent for per-task mechanical doc sync. Reads task diff, reverse-lookups changed files to concepts via INDEX.json, applies surgical updates to AUTO-START/AUTO-END delimited machine-truth fields in human-tier and LLM-tier docs. Stages updates; reconciliation applies after all tasks.

Tier 2 narrative doc system. Accumulates tier2-context.json incrementally across pipeline phases (z-plan, z-implement-all, z-review-all). /z-doc-rationale command spawns Pro subagent to produce ADRs, design rationale, and migration guides. Significance-gated by three-signal OR.
System-level behavioral invariants — permanent per-repo truths consumed by /z-test for behavioral test generation.

File-based review capture via codex -o flag. Capability-probed per-PPID sentinel (greps `codex exec --help` for `output-last-message`); -o appended only for codex provider (providers.json unchanged). Full review written to archive/tasks/<id>/review-cycle<N>.md as source of truth; orchestrator receives only verdict+counts+artifact-path. Explicit fallback to stdout capture emits review_capture_fallback {id,cycle,reason} (consultants add role field). response_chars = captured-review size (honest), not discarded transcript. Non-codex path byte-identical to today.

Per-subagent cost telemetry. detect-host.sh prints claude|pi|codex|cursor|antigravity (default claude, positive-marker overrides only, never unknown/empty). host stamped on EVERY event by log-event.sh (lazy: Z_HARNESS_HOST env var else detect-host.sh once, cached to /tmp/zh-host-$PPID). log-subagent.sh emits subagent_call {host,role,subagent_type,subagent_model,prompt_chars,response_chars,provider_input_tokens?,provider_output_tokens?}; non-fatal (always exits 0). HONEST LIMITATION: for native Claude Agent() subagents prompt_chars/response_chars are exact character counts not token counts; real provider_*_tokens only from external CLIs printing a usage line. D9: prompt_chars and response_chars kept SEPARATE (no collapsed est_tokens). Drift-guard CI: test_subagent_logging.sh greps Agent( sites, fails if no paired log-subagent.sh call or # no-subagent-log opt-out. Read-side: estimate-tokens.py subagent-costs weights input vs output rates, groups by host+subagent_type, labels char-est vs real-tokens.

Opt-in pre-review gate-down at the per-task implement gate. Z_HARNESS_IMPL_PRE_REVIEW default 0 (SHIPS INERT; knob-off is byte-identical to today). When on: Step 6.P1 tier-drift re-check via complexity-classifier (must strip cached **Complexity:** line; drift-up emits tier_drift_detected and forces codex). Step 6.P2 gate-down (low-tier only): Flash pre-reviewer dispatch; CLEAN verdict skips codex + emits review_gated_down; flagged verdict escalates to codex with Flash findings prepended as FLASH_PREPEND. Medium/high always go to codex unchanged. Flash unavailable emits pre_review_skipped + falls through to codex (fail-safe toward more thorough review). COST-INVERSION CAVEAT: Flash-on-all + codex-on-subset can invert cost vs codex-on-all. EVIDENCE GATE: knob is undocumented-as-recommended until scripts/audit-preview-misses.sh shows acceptable Flash false-negative rate.

Middle-gear attended chain orchestrator. Auto-advances through a command chain (default preset attend-full = plan,audit,test,implement-all,review-all), halts and asks inline only on the four halt categories (decision/risk/shortcut/archiving), auto-proceeds mechanical_proceed gates with skill_default, and yields for a real user /clear at declared yield_after boundaries (plan, implement-all). Resume validates a hardened handoff.json protocol-1.1 predicate: HEAD SHA mismatch=HARD HALT, phase/cursor disagree=HARD HALT, session_id unchanged=WARN, done-set/dirty drift=WARN. Gate policy lives in z-attend.md; sequencing/state mechanics live in chain-runner.sh (policy separation Invariant 2). Untagged gates always resolve to 'ask' (Invariant 1 fail-safe). Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt is never set.

Hermes parallelism layer — ACTIVATED (v1.3, T001-T015 complete, 2026-06-12). Within-plan DAG concurrency: generate-workstreams.py assigns parallel_group=level-{depth} via assign_ws_depths; hermes-execute.py runs level-aware loop: compute_ready_level → partition_level (greedy graph-coloring, HIGH-severity serialization) → asyncio.gather bounded by asyncio.Semaphore(max_parallel_workstreams) held for full run_workstream lifetime. Cross-plan: run_cross_plan builds conflict graph via build_plan_conflict_graph (scope intersection or scope_unknown → conflict), acquires sorted-slug plan-claim locks (INV-6 deadlock-free), schedules disjoint plans concurrently bounded by max_parallel_plans. Single in-process asyncio.Lock serializes all merge_workstream calls across workstreams and plans. Default caps=1 (opt-in via HERMES_MAX_PARALLEL / HERMES_MAX_PARALLEL_PLANS; INV-5: cap=1 ≡ legacy sequential). Non-file shared state not protected — use HERMES_SERIALIZE_ALL=1 escape hatch. 7 invariants: INV-1 worktree write-safety, INV-2 depends_on authoritative, INV-3 merge_order authoritative, INV-4 fail-safe serialize on unknown scope, INV-5 cap=1 ≡ legacy, INV-6 deadlock-free sorted locks, INV-7 forward-compatible additive schema fields.

Default z-harness paradigm (workflow.planning_mode=intent). Replaces thick SPEC/PLAN/TASKS with: thin frozen INTENT.md contract (frozen at /z-implement-all start, immutable thereafter — INV-1); emergent BFS task-tree generated one level at a time by task-tree-generator (Sonnet); append-only LEDGER.md as realized-plan audit trail. Level depth (L1 quick / L2 standard / L3 deep) chosen by intent-classifier (Haiku, advisory) or config-forced. /z-implement-all mode detection: SPEC.md present → legacy unchanged (INV-4); INTENT.md present → INTENT engine (freeze→bootstrap-ledger→BFS loop→evaluate-acceptance per level). Four new workflow.* knobs in config.py (lines 78–81): planning_mode, intent_level, intent_parallel_levels (default false), hermes_enabled (default false, INV-6). /z-amend re-opens via reopen-intent (scripts/intent-schema.py:377). /z-do → /z-plan --quick shim; /z-plan-light → /z-plan --standard shim.

Shared amendment-brief renderer and gate-decision helper for the default-amend continuation path in /z-audit-plan and /z-review-all. scripts/amendment-brief.py: file/stdin JSON {corrections:[{title,why,target}], approach_concerns:[{concern,affected?,suggestion?}]} -> two-section markdown brief: 'Patched automatically (N corrections)' (always) + 'Worth your eyes (M)' (only when approach_concerns non-empty; absent affected -> 'rework this, or proceed?'). scripts/amend-gate-decision.py: maps workflow.audit_to_amend resolver (result,source) -> auto_split|force_ask|halt using 5-rule precedence (halt wins; skip->auto_split; source==none->auto_split; explicit-config/memory+ask|prefill->force_ask; fallback->auto_split). Both commands call the same renderer. Discriminator is Class not severity: spec_gap=correction (auto-amended), premise_failure=approach (rendered as prose).

Pre-implementation plan audit pipeline: reality-check (Phase 1), best-practices/design (Phase 2), adversarial cross-LLM review (Phase 3), Class-tagged synthesis (Phase 4), default-amend gate (Phase 5). Phase 4 tags every surviving finding spec_gap or premise_failure (from z-review-all.md:716 enum; correction/approach are glosses only). Phase 5 default (source==none) is auto_split — no popup: INTENT-mode batches all spec_gap into ONE /z-amend call (single contract re-freeze); legacy-mode per-finding; premise_failure rendered via amendment-brief.py as conversational prose. force_ask fires only when amend-gate-decision.py returns force_ask (explicit config|memory ask|prefill preference). halt unchanged. audit_auto_split telemetry emitted on auto_split path. workflow.audit_to_amend is SOURCE-KEYED: stored value alone does not determine behavior; resolver source is the discriminator.

Final-gate cross-LLM review after /z-implement-all. Two consultant subagents (Gemini+Codex) on cumulative diff vs plan contract (SPEC in legacy; frozen INTENT+LEDGER in INTENT mode). Class enum at line 716 is canonical: implementation_drift|spec_gap|completed_task_contradiction|premise_failure|observation. Phase 6.5: unconditionally auto-amends every amendment_proposal (spec_gap) via /z-amend --skip-user-gate; no per-finding popup; skips [x] tasks; writes auto-amend-log.md; emits auto_amend_applied per amendment. Phase 6.6: renders unified amendment brief via scripts/amendment-brief.py (corrections=Phase-6.5 spec_gaps, approach_concerns=premise_failure escalations); writes amendment-brief.md to archive; Finalize APPROACH_FILE prefers amendment-brief.md over older seed. Phase 6.6 skipped when both lists empty. ## Escalations in REVIEW-TASKS.md preserved as archive record; amendment-brief.md is the active presentation layer.
